name: story-team-kit
description: 9-agent story team + graph memory cho orca-superpowers-workflow — portable install. Tự chứa đủ để chạy local.superpowers-launcher trên máy mới.

external.orca-app: Orca app (worktrees, gates, Linear, orchestration) — cung cấp sẵn skills: orca-cli, orchestration, orca-linear trong orca/skills/
external.local-superpowers-launcher: git clone https://github.com/VuHoi/local.superpowers-launcher (private) — panel điều khiển, cần kit này + 2 mục trên

provides.name: orca-superpowers-workflow
provides.outputs: 6-phase pipeline spec→plan→execute→review→verify với orca infra (worktree/DAG/gates/Linear sync) tự động

provides.name: story-workflow
provides.outputs: epic bracket + Linear SFs + STORY-COMPLETE report

provides.name: orca-bridge
provides.outputs: bridge action: worktree+Linear link, decision gate, task DAG, review coordination, status sync

provides.name: writing-plans-linear
provides.outputs: plan.md + Linear subtasks per milestone (Write/Publish modes)

provides.name: mock-prototype
provides.outputs: 3 hướng HTML prototype → unlisted artifact links → user chọn → final hand-off

provides.name: post-task-ritual
provides.outputs: skill update + memory index + cleared log (7 steps)

provides.name: designer
provides.outputs: 3 hướng HTML draft → user chọn → hand-off spec (DESIGN-BLOCKED khi thiếu)

provides.name: code-reviewer
provides.outputs: VERDICT: APPROVED | CHANGES-REQUESTED | REJECT-AND-REVERT + P0/P1/P2 findings

provides.name: verifier
provides.outputs: VERDICT: PASS — <bằng chứng> | PARTIAL | FAIL + Gate Status

provides.name: spec-critic
provides.outputs: VERDICT: PROCEED | FIX-P0-FIRST + P0/P1/P2 critique report

provides.name: plan-critic
provides.outputs: VERDICT: PROCEED | FIX-P0-FIRST + P0/P1/P2 critique report

provides.name: phase0-impact-analyst
provides.outputs: 5-section impact analysis (framing, touch map, second-order, alternatives, risks) — IMPACT-BLOCKED khi thiếu

provides.name: security-audit
provides.outputs: VERDICT: CLEAN | FINDINGS — P0/P1/P2 counts + top finding

provides.name: rollback-fixer
provides.outputs: ROLLBACK-DONE: reverted <commits> | ROLLBACK-BLOCKED: <lý do> + audit trail

provides.name: story-attempt
provides.description: track debugging attempts — chặn lặp cùng cách fail (3 lần cùng approach → buộc đổi hướng)

provides.name: story-compact-recovery
provides.description: SessionStart hook (matcher: compact) — inject lời nhắc khôi phục story state sau mỗi lần compaction

provides.name: story-diff-review
provides.description: tự review diff trước commit — chặn debug code, commented-out code, secrets, files ngoài plan

provides.name: story-impact
provides.description: Bản đồ tác động: file đổi/targets → importer ngược theo feature area → lưới test vitest --related; P0 dùng --targets ký hợp đồng blast radius, review đo actual so expected
inputs: git base ref (tự detect nếu bỏ)
--targets "p1,p2" (P0: blast radius touch targets, không cần git)
provides.outputs: bản đồ reverse-import + areas bị chạm + lệnh lưới test; exit != 0 khi base sai

provides.name: story-launch
provides.description: nguồn duy nhất dựng SF launch prompt + tạo worktree — PM/watchdog/panel đều gọi

provides.name: story-memory
provides.description: consumer layer graph memory — đọc docs/superpowers/memory/{entities,triples,provenance}.md (CLI chỉ đọc)

provides.name: story-memory-fuse
provides.description: fusion rules cho memory files — dedupe triple/provenance, refuse entity xung đột (exit 2), rewrite idempotent

provides.name: story-memory-index-hook
provides.description: post-pass incremental index graph memory — đọc watermark git, index commit mới

provides.name: story-memory-parse
provides.description: validate/roundtrip memory files — entities/triples/provenance, 1 dòng = 1 record

provides.name: story-notify
provides.description: thông báo có context, screenshot, đề xuất — story-notify <type> <sf> [detail]

provides.name: story-notify-toast.ps1
provides.description: toast WinRT cho story-notify trên Windows — WinPS 5.1 -File (không bypass/encode, windows-edr-posture), script gọi cạnh nó

provides.name: story-post-merge
provides.description: verify sau merge — tests + browser flow + agents

provides.name: story-preflight
provides.description: chạy trước khi code — chặn sai branch, tree dirty, deps thiếu; cảnh báo server chết, DB trống, .env thiếu

provides.name: story-resume
provides.description: sf|verdict|detail status lines cho watchdog

provides.name: story-skill-lint
provides.description: structural integrity check cho story-workflow SKILL.md — bắt mất bước spec-critic/plan-critic

provides.name: story-snapshot-env
provides.description: chụp trạng thái môi trường trước/sau thay đổi lớn — story-snapshot-env [tag]

provides.name: story-stats
provides.description: số liệu vận hành per SF — cycle-time, khối lượng, events sống sót (Linear GraphQL + worktree git)

provides.name: story-status
provides.description: 30 giây nắm tình hình mọi story active — story nào chạy, SF Done/chạy/chờ

provides.name: story-sync-dest
provides.description: đưa meta commits từ main vào nhánh đích an toàn — wrapper sync của story-workflow

provides.name: story-test
provides.description: RULE 0 enforcer — tự mở browser đi flow, phải PASS trước khi tick Done

provides.name: story-top
provides.description: một màn hình theo dõi mọi agent đang chạy (Orca + ngoài Orca) — watch-style tự refresh

provides.name: story-verify
provides.description: enforce COMPLETE-RUN CHECKLIST 5 bước trước Linear Done — exit 0 sạch / 1 INCOMPLETE / 2 VIOLATION

provides.name: story-visual-regress
provides.description: so screenshot hiện tại vs baseline — --baseline <dir> --current <dir> [--threshold 5]

provides.name: story-watchdog
provides.description: self-sustainment loop — diagnose mọi SF, notify khi stall mới, optionally launch next

provides.name: hook-post-tool-use
provides.description: wrapper PostToolUse cho settings.json — resolve story-checkpoint record, nuốt missing-bin (exit 0 im lặng)

provides.name: hook-session-start
provides.description: wrapper SessionStart cho settings.json — resolve story-fact-pack, stdout inject vào context, nuốt missing-bin

provides.name: hook-stop
provides.description: wrapper Stop cho settings.json — no-op SF-2 (logic audit lessons SF-3 thay bên trong), nuốt mọi input

provides.name: story-checkpoint
provides.description: session memory + checkpoint CLI — record git commit thành JSONL v-stamped, query/restore/prune-refs/stats (SF-1 GH-26)

provides.name: story-fact-pack
provides.description: SessionStart hook — inject fact-pack (story đang chạy + gates pending + tail checkpoint) ≤2KB vào context (SF-2 GH-26)

provides.name: story-hooks-install
provides.description: merge 3 hook entries vào ~/.claude/settings.json — atomic RMW, idempotent, giữ entry user/Orca (SF-2 GH-26; runtime chính trong installKit Node)

provides.name: story-lesson
provides.description: lessons provenance CLI + Stop audit — add/list schema-validated ghi lessons.jsonl qua atomic+stamp, stop-audit đếm theo session (SF-3 GH-26)

provides.name: story-report-validate
provides.description: schema-validate REPORT fence của task-executor (GH-40) — strict-reject: MISSING-FIELD <name> (got: <v>) / BAD-STATUS / NONE-ON-DONE / UNCLOSED-REPORT, legacy no-fence WARN LEGACY-REPORT (FAIL từ kit 2.8.0); stdin primary + --file, exit 0/1/2

provides.name: story-review-fuse
provides.description: gộp findings nhiều OUTBOX reviews/<agent>-<sf>*.md (GH-32) — parse tolerant bullet+bảng, cluster (file, line±10, severity), sort confidence, conf-thấp → NEEDS VERIFICATION; heading ### Deterministic = kênh facts tool (2.14.3), NEEDS VERIFICATION bullets → needs bucket, Surgical-scope/[coverage] → kênh attest (2.14.4); KHÔNG bao giờ drop finding (invariant in_ra == parsed+unparsed+facts+attest)

provides.name: story-surface-lint
provides.description: bounded rewrite enforcer (constitution VI) — diff từ base-ref: rename surface công khai đòi alias_of + migration guide + expiry YYYY-MM-DD; hết hạn FAIL

provides.name: wakii-mcp-server
provides.description: read-only MCP server (stdio) — bracket/gate/watchdog/tasklist tools cho agent bên ngoài kit; task/gate-list nhận run param (--run, 2.14.4); version fallback marker khi installed layout

provides.name: wakii-skill-export
provides.description: export skills ra pack (dirs + INDEX.md + package.json) để community cài vào harness khác

provides.name: wakii-skill-import
provides.description: import 1 skill chuẩn Claude (thư mục SKILL.md) vào kit — validate + collide provides[], owner community/<nguồn>, bump version

provides.name: story-smoke
provides.description: Runtime smoke gate — chạy smoke command SF + scan ERROR + ghi evidence cho B3.5

provides.name: story-sequence
provides.description: Mermaid sequenceDiagram quá trình chạy thật của story — git + Linear verdicts + evidence, không cần LLM

provides.name: story-mindmap
provides.description: sinh file mindmap .wakii schema v1 của story từ bracket + context pack + story-impact — 3 lớp tiến độ/logic/impact, idempotent (generatedAt chỉ bump khi payload đổi), atomic; --decode verdict cho consumer

provides.name: wakii-validate
provides.description: validate file .wakii schema v1 — exit 0/1/2, verdict OK/INVALID/WARN; luật §3 + story-level (sf/linear/tier/deps) + --linear kiểm ID tồn tại (fail-open) + --resolve-primary

provides.name: story-mindmap-trigger
provides.description: wrapper fail-open 3 lifecycle trigger story-mindmap (launch/sweep/close) — nuốt missing-bin + timeout 30s, --commit force-add cho close

provides.name: story-distributed-claim
provides.description: Claim CLI distributed — --claim/--machine-id/--host/--list-claims (FI-458)

provides.name: story-kb
provides.description: query Project KB (ADR/repos/glossary/MOC) tu configurable dir (WAKII_KB_DIR) - fail-open khi KB chua configured; layer 1 ADE knowledge infra (#38)

provides.name: story-plan-validate
provides.description: kiểm task DAG của orchestration run — bắt lỗi DAG ngay sau Bridge 3 (học từ story-validate)

provides.name: story-coordinator-pass
provides.description: MỘT lượt coordination pass bounded — run discovery → ownership probe → inbox (question/escalation/worker_done verify evidence) → stall sweep → PASS SUMMARY; automation chỉ cần gọi 1 dòng (LOCAL-1 SF-1)

provides.name: story-automation-install
provides.description: installer idempotent cho Orca automation coordinator-pass + morning briefing — cron tuỳ chọn, workspace existing, retire sạch (LOCAL-1 SF-2)

provides.name: story-ownership-probe
provides.description: thư viện ownership probe dùng chung — run/worktree nào đang có worker live của coordinator nào (LOCAL-1 SF-3)

provides.name: story-medic
provides.description: Story cấp cứu — chẩn đoán + điều trị SF stall và xung đột session (watchdog báo STALLED, session chết giữa turn, nghi double-dispatch, absorb provenance run cũ). KHÔNG sửa code, KHÔNG quyết done-semantics, KHÔNG xoá state.
provides.outputs: verdict per worktree (live/idle/resumed/escalate) + actions taken + còn treo

provides.name: story-close
provides.description: chuẩn hoá CLOSE phase — audit sf-branches merged → ownership probe → cleanup worktree/branch (3 guards) → next-steps; BLOCK liệt kê rõ, fail-open khi probe chết (20/09)

provides.name: linear-rate-limit
provides.description: state machine Linear rate-limit — check/note/clear/pending/classify (policy skip+note+resume 2026-09-20)

provides.name: story-doctor
provides.description: kit health check read-only — 8 checks PASS/WARN/FAIL + fix hint trên install dir: marker/kitHash/bins/deps/hooks/KB/orphans/agents-skills; --json machine-readable, exit 0 WARN-only / 1 khi FAIL (GH-85 #111)

provides.name: story-guard-secrets
provides.description: PreToolUse Bash guard chặn secret trong command (AKIA/ghp_/xox/assignment quoted 20+) — exit 2 block, fail-open mọi lỗi, WAKII_GUARD_OFF=1 tắt (GH-87)

provides.name: story-guard-dangerous
provides.description: PreToolUse Bash guard chặn rm -rf /|~ · git push --force/-f lên wakii-dev|main|master · git reset --hard trên repo chính wakii — exit 2, fail-open, GUARD_OFF escape (GH-87)

provides.name: story-guard-envfiles
provides.description: PreToolUse Edit|Write|MultiEdit guard chặn ghi .env/.env.*/pem/id_rsa*/key — exit 2, fail-open, GUARD_OFF escape (GH-87)

provides.name: vscode-sync-dispatch
provides.description: điều phối sync feature VS Code — 1 pass 1 feature, mỗi feature qua story-workflow đầy đủ; state machine trong docs/superpowers/vscode-sync/backlog.md ([ ] chờ / [~] đang chạy / [x] đã merged)

provides.name: story-pr-checks
provides.description: CI gate cho PR truoc khi merge — doc gh pr checks (cung nguon Checks panel): exit 0 pass/no-checks, 1 fail, 2 pending, 3 loi
